(no text could be extracted from the project page)

## HN discussion (2 comments)

- [other] BElluu: I do not know why, but it's so laggy on my PC in chrome. When I cut some ink or do some chaotic moves it's more than 1000ms Presentation delay
- [author] georgestrakhov: yes, definitely some optimizations are due if you go beyond 20-30 moves or move fast. would love a PR on that if anyone cares!

{"decision": "pass", "reason": "快照能看出这是一个浏览器里的墨流（suminagashi）模拟，有墨色、吹气、发丝、漂移等工具，但页面文字没读到，也看不出实现机制或相对常见做法的具体改动。评论里作者自己承认超过20到30步就卡顿，说明它还只是可玩的演示，不足以打断读者。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason's claims are supported by the evidence: the accessibility snapshot shows ink colors and Blow, Hair and Drift controls, no page text was extracted, and the author acknowledged that optimizations are needed past 20-30 moves. These concrete details, plus the reason's judgment that it is only a playable demo with no visible mechanism, support the pass decision.
